plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) A check of each category against the requester's rule (C3). No instrument in the library reads categories against a rule, so C3 cannot be shown before the promotion. (2) A scope check on the reads of the 100 accounts (C5). Scope of a call can be named only on lines of the record and costs 10 per line, so at most five lines fit the allowance of 50 for the whole session, and it cannot be put in the plan. (3) An outbox check on every sending call (C10). Trace of a call is named-lines only, at A3, at 10 per line, so 100 sends cost 1000 and only a sample is affordable from the allowance. (4) A live-table read after promotion. The live state is tied to the staged set only by the promotion's line, and the library reads the live tables only in the undo rehearsal, which is a copy and is valid for one hour. The plan therefore leaves C3, C5 and C10 unshown, and I would not approve A1 or A2 on the basis of those clauses. Any sampling of C5 or C10 would have to come from the 50 allowance during the work.
